about_the_game:
My Townies Features:

  • Access to All Features with Infinite hours of gameplay

  • Access to All Updates and New Mini Games Events

  • Access to All Buildings and Upgrades

  • Start with a small farm settlement and grow it into a thriving metropolis

  • Tons of Arcade style mini games 

  • Limitless design opportunities—build the metropolis of your dreams!

  • Develop and decorate and manage your town, produce and gather goods, and complete your townies tasks and orders!

  • Construct and upgrade buildings to improve productivity and townie well-being.

  • Every townie has unique skills, needs, and personalities.

  • Assign townies to jobs to keep the city running.

  • Train and develop townies to unlock their full potential.

  • The choices you make shape your towns/city’s legacy.

  • Sandbox endless gameplay and more

In this immersive city-building game, you’re not just an overseer; you’re the guiding force of a growing civilization. Begin with a modest farm settlement and transform it into a sprawling metropolis, with every townie, building, and resource under your command. Carefully manage resources to keep your townies thriving and happy as they work, learn, and grow under your direction. Customize every aspect of the city by upgrading buildings, assigning jobs, and planning expansions to accommodate the community’s evolving needs.

Each townie is unique, with their own skills and preferences, and they rely on you for guidance. Whether directing the farmer to harvest crops, training police officers to protect the city, or upgrading homes to improve comfort, you have the power to shape their lives. As your town advances, unlock new technologies and building upgrades, letting you create grand structures, enhance production chains, and optimize every aspect of your bustling society.

Gather valuable resources, and trade with neighboring cities to fuel growth. The choices you make will impact your city’s success, as well as its legacy. Lead your people to prosperity and watch as your small town becomes a legendary city known for its beauty, resilience, and harmony.
